photo.caption: A portrait of an unknown man previously identified as Ignatius Sancho, or as Equiano, in the Royal Albert Memorial Museum, Exeter
photo.description: Portrait of a Man in a Red Suit is an important artwork, yet the artist and sitter remain unknown. Many people have tried to identify both with little success. Initially the painter was thought to be the great Plympton-born artist Sir Joshua Reynolds, however this was refuted in 1969. During the 1960s historians speculated that the sitter was Olaudah Equiano; this was believed up until 2006 when John Madin proposed the identity of the sitter to be Charles Ignatius Sancho and the artist to be Allan Ramsay.
